About Blue Triangle

# Founded on the belief that every friction point has a price tag.

We built the only Revenue Assurance platform that quantifies the cost of digital friction, tells you what to fix first, and proves the ROI of fixing it.

[Request a Demo](https://bluetriangle.com/schedule-demo)

![h_img](https://bluetriangle.com/hubfs/BlueTriangle_2026/Images/h_img.png)

Our Vision

## Measuring friction in the only currency that matters

Hidden friction in your customers' digital journeys is costing your brand millions — in lost conversions, in abandoned carts, in customers who don't come back.

Most teams already know friction is a problem. What they lack is a way to measure it in the currency that matters: revenue. Without that, even the best digital teams are prioritizing by instinct, debating in meetings and shipping fixes they hope will move the needle.

We built Blue Triangle to change that.

Our Revenue Assurance platform is the only closed-loop solution that begins by quantifying exactly how much revenue each friction point is costing you — on every page, across every journey — and ends by validating the dollars you recovered after resolving it. The engine behind this is our proprietary Conversion Rate Curve methodology, refined over 10 years and billions of transactions across 150+ leading brands.

The result: your teams stop guessing and start prioritizing the work that actually moves revenue. Engineering, marketing, and leadership align around one shared metric. And every optimization you make comes with proof attached.

That's what we mean by Continuous Experience Optimization — and it's what only Blue Triangle delivers.
